relationships.subject: indomethacin
relationships.evidence_quote: Indomethacin reduced myotube fusion at high concentrations

key_findings: High-concentration indomethacin reduced PGE2, myoblast proliferation, p70S6K phosphorylation and myotube fusion in human primary muscle cells.
Ibuprofen and naproxen had little effect; flurbiprofen had biphasic effects on proliferation.
